subject: APAC + EU dedicated pool sizing for Q3 booking - preliminary ask
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@finstack.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Bellini <marco.bellini@finstack.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated pools for APAC + EU for Q3 rollout

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked good. We're lining up our Q3 rollout and want to understand how Redwood would size dedicated capacity for our use case across APAC and EU. High level: we'll route customer-facing inference to APAC (Singapore) and EU (Frankfurt) regions with occasional failover to US. Key signals:

- Peak concurrent sessions: ~1,200 sessions across regions (expected split 60% APAC / 30% EU / 10% US)
- Average prompt + generation length: ~400 tokens (prompt 150 / gen 250)
- Target p50 latency: <250ms for short-chat flows, p95 <700ms
- Expected sustained Q3 RPS during launch weeks: 400–800 rps (spiky)
- Business asks: price for reserved capacity (monthly commit), preferred GPU types (A100, H100), and lead time for private pool in APAC (we need VPC options)

I've attached our current traffic forecast (finstack_q3_traffic_forecast.xlsx). Can you put together an initial sizing and a mutual action plan so procurement can start budgeting?

Best,
Claire
VP Product
FinStack AI
[attachment: finstack_q3_traffic_forecast.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@finstack.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools for APAC + EU for Q3 rollout

Claire — really helpful detail, thanks and great to hear the demo lined up with expectations. I've looped in Karthik (infra sizing) and Marissa (enterprise ops / procurement) to draft a preliminary sizing and M.A.P. A few clarifying Qs before we lock numbers:

- Do you have a target concurrency per session (tokens/sec) or a typical generation rate?
- Are you planning streaming token-by-token to clients or batch-complete responses server-side?
- Any hard latency SLOs for p99?
- Will embeddings/reranking traffic be colocated with generation or routed to a separate route?
- Any requirements on model (open model family, specific weights) or quantization?

We can provide two sizing options: cost-optimized (quantized LlamaX variants on A100 80GB) and performance-first (H100-backed pools + higher KV cache capacity). I'll aim to get an initial worksheet back within 24 hours.

Thanks — Jonas
Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@finstack.ai>, Marco Bellini <marco.bellini@finstack.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools for APAC + EU for Q3 rollout

Folks — I put together an initial sizing sketch in the attached redwood-q3-sizing-v1.xlsx. Summary notes:

- Baseline assumptions: 60% APAC / 30% EU / 10% US split, avg payload 400 tokens; assume 250 tokens/sec per session peak.
- APAC pool (SG): recommended starting config = 6 x H100 (32GB) nodes with 2 inference instances per GPU using H100-optimized kernels; this targets sustained 600 rps with headroom for spikes; KV cache configured per-instance to keep recent prefixes hot.
- EU pool (FRA): 3 x A100-80GB nodes, cost-conscious config with autoscale to burst into shared cloud capacity if needed; predicted sustained 250 rps.
- US fallback: small 1–2 GPU standby (A100) in us-west for DR/failover.

Lead times: APAC private VPC provisioning + certs ~3–5 weeks (depends on customer infra approvals); GPU procurement and reserved capacity scheduling for H100s in APAC currently shows 6–8 week lead time for dedicated pools if we need physical colocated racks. If hosted Dedicated is acceptable we can get pools live in 2–3 weeks.

Open items for Claire: exact p99 SLOs, expected percent of streaming vs non-streaming responses, and whether embeddings workload should be colocated.

[attachment: redwood-q3-sizing-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@finstack.ai>

Date: 2026-04-19T08:22:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools for APAC + EU for Q3 rollout

Karthik / Jonas — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications:

- p99 target should be <900ms for the customer-facing flows; p50 target stays <250ms. p99 is more important during launch weeks.
- We'll stream responses to clients (token streaming) for chat UX.
- Embeddings will be separate pipeline (not high volume initially) — route to a shared host in EU.
- We'll prioritize APAC (SG) HARD requirement for VPC and private pool; EU can be hosted-dedicated initially.

Budget guidance: procurement has tentatively approved a monthly committed budget up to $65k/mo for Q3 if we can prove the p99 numbers and show a fallback plan.

I'll review your spreadsheet and get back with exact concurrency per session by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Claire
